{"by":"the template","client":"-- Crag Trial's bike drawn by the movement's draw hook (Kit's players.lua):
-- the frame, the wheels and the rider as boxes under the body's node, posed
-- from s.pose (crag_bike.lua's: its angle, its facing, the wheels from the
-- feet and their turns), this client's own as predicted, the others' as the
-- server's last step left them
local magic = require("buildat/extension/urho3d")
local log = buildat.Logger("crag_bike")
local LIFT, R = 0.74, 0.36 -- crag_bike.lua's: the middle over the feet, a wheel's radius
local mats = {}
local said = false

local function mat(hex)
	if not mats[hex] then
		local m = magic.Material:new()
		m:SetTechnique(0, magic.cache:GetResource("Technique",
				"Techniques/NoTexture.xml"))
		m:SetShaderParameter("MatDiffColor", magic.Color(tonumber(hex:sub(2, 3), 16) / 255,
				tonumber(hex:sub(4, 5), 16) / 255, tonumber(hex:sub(6, 7), 16) / 255))
		mats[hex] = m
	end
	return mats[hex]
end

local function part(root, name, model, color)
	local n = root:CreateChild(name)
	local m = n:CreateComponent("StaticModel")
	m.model = magic.cache:GetResource("Model", "Models/" .. model .. ".mdl")
	m.material = mat(color)
	m.castShadows = true
	return n
end

-- A box from a to b in the body's node, t thick (z depth d)
local function seg(n, a, b, t, d)
	local dx, dy = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]
	n.position = magic.Vector3((a[1] + b[1]) / 2, (a[2] + b[2]) / 2, 0)
	n.rotation = magic.Quaternion(0, 0, math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)))
	n.scale = magic.Vector3(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + t, t, d or t)
end

local function build(node)
	local b = node:CreateChild("crag_bike")
	for _, k in ipairs({"wl", "wr"}) do
		local wh = b:CreateChild(k)
		local tyre = part(wh, "tyre", "Cylinder", "#26282b")
		tyre.rotation = magic.Quaternion(90, 0, 0)
		tyre.scale = magic.Vector3(2 * R, 0.16, 2 * R)
		local hub = part(wh, "hub", "Cylinder", "#b8bcc0")
		hub.rotation = magic.Quaternion(90, 0, 0)
		hub.scale = magic.Vector3(1.3 * R, 0.17, 1.3 * R)
		local spoke = part(wh, "spoke", "Box", "#3a3d42")
		spoke.scale = magic.Vector3(1.5 * R, 0.06, 0.18)
	end
	for _, k in ipairs({"back", "down", "fork", "tank"}) do
		part(b, k, "Box", "#2a9d8f")
	end
	part(b, "seat", "Box", "#1d1f22")
	part(b, "bars", "Box", "#1d1f22")
	for _, k in ipairs({"leg", "shin", "torso", "arm"}) do
		part(b, k, "Box", k == "torso" and "#e9c46a" or "#3d5a80")
	end
	part(b, "head", "Sphere", "#f4f1ea").scale = magic.Vector3(0.44, 0.44, 0.44)
	return b
end

return {
	draw = function(s, node)
		local p = type(s.pose) == "table" and s.pose or {}
		local a, dir = tonumber(p[1]) or 0, tonumber(p[2]) or 1
		local dead = dir > 1 or dir < -1
		dir = dir < 0 and -1 or 1
		local b = node:GetChild("crag_bike", false) or build(node)
		if not said then
			said = true
			log:info("crag_bike: the draw hook draws a bike")
		end
		local ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
		-- A point of the frame (its middle 0, 0, facing +x) in the node
		local function at(x, y)
			x = x * dir
			return {x * ca - y * sa, LIFT + x * sa + y * ca}
		end
		local wl, wr = {tonumber(p[3]) or -0.62, tonumber(p[4]) or 0.38},
			{tonumber(p[5]) or 0.62, tonumber(p[6]) or 0.38}
		for k, wp in pairs({wl = wl, wr = wr}) do
			local n = b:GetChild(k, false)
			n.position = magic.Vector3(wp[1], wp[2], 0)
			n.rotation = magic.Quaternion(0, 0, math.deg(tonumber(p[k == "wl" and 7 or 8]) or 0))
		end
		-- The wheels as the frame faces: the back one driven
		local back, front = dir > 0 and wl or wr, dir > 0 and wr or wl
		local seat, head = at(-0.2, 0.32), at(-0.08, 0.86)
		local bars, foot = at(0.42, 0.5), at(0.02, -0.06)
		seg(b:GetChild("back", false), back, at(-0.1, 0.12), 0.09)
		seg(b:GetChild("down", false), at(-0.1, 0.12), at(0.36, 0.38), 0.11)
		seg(b:GetChild("fork", false), front, bars, 0.08)
		seg(b:GetChild("tank", false), at(0.0, 0.3), at(0.32, 0.36), 0.2, 0.3)
		seg(b:GetChild("seat", false), at(-0.42, 0.3), at(-0.05, 0.3), 0.08, 0.3)
		seg(b:GetChild("bars", false), at(0.4, 0.5), at(0.42, 0.52), 0.06, 0.6)
		-- The rider: crashed, slumped over the bars
		local hip, sh = seat, dead and at(0.2, 0.45) or at(-0.02, 0.7)
		local knee = at(0.18, 0.18)
		seg(b:GetChild("leg", false), hip, knee, 0.14)
		seg(b:GetChild("shin", false), knee, foot, 0.12)
		seg(b:GetChild("torso", false), hip, sh, 0.24, 0.3)
		seg(b:GetChild("arm", false), sh, bars, 0.1)
		local hd = dead and at(0.34, 0.6) or head
		b:GetChild("head", false).position = magic.Vector3(hd[1], hd[2], 0)
	end,
}
","source":"-- Crag Trial's bike: a movement (kit/controls' movement) for the side view,
-- stepped in the plane (x right, y up). A frame with an angle and two wheels
-- on springs under it, gravity; the wheels and the rider's head meet the
-- ground (a heightmap's or voxels) and the polygons (w:circle). The keys: W (Gas) the back wheel's
-- motor, S (Brake) both wheels held, A and D lean the bike as the screen
-- shows it (A counter-clockwise, D clockwise, whichever way it faces), Space
-- (Turn) faces the other way. The rider's head on
-- anything is a crash: the event "crash" (its output), the bike still a
-- second, then back where it started (its first step's place).
-- Its state: s.c the frame's middle and velocity {x, y, vx, vy}, s.a its angle
-- (radians, counter-clockwise), s.av its turn, s.dir 1 facing +x or -1, s.wl
-- and s.wr the wheels {x, y, vx, vy, spin (the tyre's speed, m/s), turn},
-- s.dead the crash's seconds left, s.start; s.pose what the clients draw
-- (crag_bike.client.lua): {a, dir (2 * dir crashed), the wheels from the feet
-- (lx, ly, rx, ry), their turns}. s.pos is the frame's middle less LIFT;
-- s.spheres the wheels and the head from it, as the zones (the gems) meet it.
-- The suspension: params stiffness and damping (the springs').
-- [KIT_BODY_VARS] The finish: a wheel on the finish line (a kit/polygon whose
-- surface is "finish") while s.vars.finish_open (crag_run's c:body_var, set
-- with the rider's last gem) holds the bike still there (s.done) till the run
-- puts it back: its own step's, on the server and in the client's prediction
-- alike, so no freeze from the server and no rewind. Without every gem it
-- rides over the line.
local R = 0.36 -- a wheel's radius
local AX, AY = 0.62, -0.36 -- the wheels' springs on the frame, from its middle
local LIFT = R - AY + 0.02 -- the middle over the feet
local HX, HY, HR = -0.08, 0.86, 0.22 -- the head, facing +x
local MC, MW, IC = 2, 0.5, 0.7 -- the frame's mass, a wheel's, the frame's inertia
local REACT = 0.06 -- the motor's turn back on the frame
local BODY = {r = 1.4, h = 2.2, eye = 0.9}

local function wheel(x, y)
	return {x, y, 0, 0, 0, 0}
end

-- Back where it started, at rest
local function reset(s)
	local x, y = s.start[1], s.start[2]
	local cx, cy = x, y + LIFT
	s.c = {cx, cy, 0, 0}
	s.a, s.av, s.dead = 0, 0, nil
	s.wl, s.wr = wheel(cx - AX, cy + AY), wheel(cx + AX, cy + AY)
end

-- A wheel's spring to its place on the frame: the force on it, the frame
-- pulled back (and turned)
local function spring(s, wh, lx, ca, sa, dt, K, D)
	local c = s.c
	local ox, oy = lx * ca - AY * sa, lx * sa + AY * ca
	local px, py = c[1] + ox, c[2] + oy
	local pvx, pvy = c[3] - s.av * oy, c[4] + s.av * ox
	local fx = -K * (wh[1] - px) - D * (wh[3] - pvx)
	local fy = -K * (wh[2] - py) - D * (wh[4] - pvy)
	wh[3], wh[4] = wh[3] + fx / MW * dt, wh[4] + fy / MW * dt
	c[3], c[4] = c[3] - fx / MC * dt, c[4] - fy / MC * dt
	s.av = s.av - (ox * fy - oy * fx) / IC * dt
end

-- A wheel against the world: out of what it is in, its speed into it gone,
-- its tyre gripping (the friction a share of the push); true and whether a
-- finish line is among what it met
local function ground(wh, w, dt)
	local touched, finish = false, false
	for k, h in ipairs(w:circle(wh[1], wh[2], R)) do
		if k > 3 then
			break
		end
		local nx, ny = h.nx, h.ny
		wh[1], wh[2] = wh[1] + nx * h.depth, wh[2] + ny * h.depth
		local vn = wh[3] * nx + wh[4] * ny
		if vn < 0 then
			wh[3], wh[4] = wh[3] - nx * vn * 1.1, wh[4] - ny * vn * 1.1
			-- Along the surface (t, the way a forward turn rolls it): the
			-- tyre's speed and the wheel's met halfway, within the grip
			local tx, ty = ny, -nx
			local slip = wh[3] * tx + wh[4] * ty - wh[5]
			local j = slip / 2
			local lim = (h.info and h.info.friction or 1) * -vn * 1.5
			j = j > lim and lim or j < -lim and -lim or j
			wh[3], wh[4] = wh[3] - tx * j, wh[4] - ty * j
			wh[5] = wh[5] + j
		end
		touched = true
		finish = finish or (h.info and h.info.surface == "finish")
	end
	return touched, finish
end

return {
	version = 1,
	about = {
		group = "Players",
		what = "Crag Trial's bike: W is the gas, S the brake, A and D lean and Space turns around; the rider's head on the ground is a crash.",
		outputs = {crash = "The rider's head hit something; the rider goes back to the start a second later."},
	},
	root = true,
	outputs = {crash = "none"},
	movement = {body = BODY, raw_keys = true, touch = "drive",
		touch_buttons = {{"Turn", "jump"}},
		touch_axes = {{"Lean left", "r", -1}, {"Lean right", "r", 1}},
		-- The help line in play, each item gone once its input is used
		help = {{"[forward]/[back]", "gas, brake", "f"},
			{"[left]/[right]", "lean", "r"}, {"[jump]", "turn round", "jump"}},
		touch_help = {{"Gas/Brake", "ride", "f"}, {"Stick", "lean", "r"},
			{"Turn", "turn round", "jump"}}},
	params = {
		gravity = {cat = "physics", type = "number", default = 14, min = 0,
			max = 100},
		speed = {cat = "physics", type = "number", default = 16, min = 1,
			max = 60},
		power = {cat = "physics", type = "number", default = 120, min = 1,
			max = 400},
		lean = {cat = "physics", type = "number", default = 24, min = 0,
			max = 200},
		stiffness = {cat = "physics", type = "number", default = 300, min = 20,
			max = 3000},
		damping = {cat = "physics", type = "number", default = 30, min = 0,
			max = 200},
		rate = {cat = "advanced", type = "number", default = 60, min = 10,
			max = 120},
		substeps = {cat = "advanced", type = "number", default = 4, min = 1,
			max = 8},
	},
	step = function(s, i, dt, w, p)
		if type(s.c) ~= "table" then
			local pos = type(s.pos) == "table" and s.pos or {0, 0, 0}
			s.start = {pos[1], pos[2]}
			s.dir = (tonumber(s.yaw) or 90) > 180 and -1 or 1
			reset(s)
		end
		local c, wl, wr = s.c, s.wl, s.wr
		local open = type(s.vars) == "table" and s.vars.finish_open
		if not open then
			s.done = nil
		end
		if s.done then
			-- (held at the finish: nothing moves)
		elseif s.dead then
			s.dead = s.dead - dt
			if s.dead <= 0 then
				reset(s)
				c, wl, wr = s.c, s.wl, s.wr
			end
		else
			local f, r = tonumber(i.f) or 0, tonumber(i.r) or 0
			-- Space turns it round (on the press)
			if i.jump == 1 and not s.held then
				s.dir = -s.dir
			end
			s.held = i.jump == 1
			local g = p.gravity or 14
			c[4] = c[4] - g * dt
			wl[4], wr[4] = wl[4] - g * dt, wr[4] - g * dt
			local ca, sa = math.cos(s.a), math.sin(s.a)
			local K, D = p.stiffness or 300, p.damping or 30
			spring(s, wl, -AX, ca, sa, dt, K, D)
			spring(s, wr, AX, ca, sa, dt, K, D)
			-- The motor on the back wheel, the brake on both
			local back = s.dir > 0 and wl or wr
			if f > 0 then
				local want = s.dir * (p.speed or 16)
				local d = want - back[5]
				local step = (p.power or 120) * f * dt
				d = d > step and step or d < -step and -step or d
				back[5] = back[5] + d
				-- (the wheel turned one way, the frame the other: a wheelie)
				s.av = s.av + REACT * d
			elseif f < 0 then
				for _, wh in ipairs({wl, wr}) do
					local step = 80 * -f * dt
					wh[5] = wh[5] > step and wh[5] - step or wh[5] < -step and
							wh[5] + step or 0
				end
			end
			-- Leaning as the screen shows it: D clockwise, A counter-clockwise,
			-- whichever way the bike faces; the whole bike turned round its
			-- middle (a wheel off the ground)
			local dw = -r * (p.lean or 24) * dt
			s.av = s.av + dw
			for _, wh in ipairs({wl, wr}) do
				wh[3], wh[4] = wh[3] - dw * (wh[2] - c[2]), wh[4] + dw * (wh[1] - c[1])
			end
			s.av = s.av * (1 - 0.6 * dt)
			c[1], c[2] = c[1] + c[3] * dt, c[2] + c[4] * dt
			s.a = s.a + s.av * dt
			local finish = false
			for _, wh in ipairs({wl, wr}) do
				wh[1], wh[2] = wh[1] + wh[3] * dt, wh[2] + wh[4] * dt
				local _, f = ground(wh, w, dt)
				finish = finish or f
				wh[6] = math.fmod(wh[6] - wh[5] / R * dt, 2 * math.pi)
			end
			-- The head
			local hx = c[1] + (HX * s.dir) * ca - HY * sa
			local hy = c[2] + (HX * s.dir) * sa + HY * ca
			local hit = w:circle(hx, hy, HR)[1]
			if hit and hit.depth > 0.02 then
				s.dead = 1
				c[3], c[4], s.av = 0, 0, 0
				for _, wh in ipairs({wl, wr}) do
					wh[3], wh[4], wh[5] = 0, 0, 0
				end
				s.events = {"crash"}
				s.crashes = (s.crashes or 0) + 1
			elseif finish and open then
				s.done = true
				c[3], c[4], s.av = 0, 0, 0
				for _, wh in ipairs({wl, wr}) do
					wh[3], wh[4], wh[5] = 0, 0, 0
				end
			end
		end
		local z = type(s.pos) == "table" and tonumber(s.pos[3]) or 0
		s.pos = {c[1], c[2] - LIFT, z}
		s.vel = {c[3], c[4], 0}
		s.yaw = s.dir > 0 and 90 or 270
		s.pose = {s.a, s.dead and 2 * s.dir or s.dir, wl[1] - c[1], wl[2] - c[2] + LIFT,
			wr[1] - c[1], wr[2] - c[2] + LIFT, wl[6], wr[6]}
		-- The wheels and the head as the zones meet them (a gem taken by a
		-- wheel), from s.pos
		local ca, sa = math.cos(s.a), math.sin(s.a)
		local px, py = s.pos[1], s.pos[2]
		s.spheres = {{wl[1] - px, wl[2] - py, 0, R}, {wr[1] - px, wr[2] - py, 0, R},
			{c[1] + HX * s.dir * ca - HY * sa - px, c[2] + HX * s.dir * sa + HY * ca - py,
				0, HR}}
	end,
}
"}

{"by":"the template","client":"","source":"-- Crag Trial's run, each rider's own: a clock from the start (a tenth at a
-- time), the gems taken (every entity linked to its input gem: all of them
-- open the finish) and the best time, on their screen (hud, to a
-- kit/ui_text whose to is "player"). A crash (crag_bike's output; the bike
-- goes back by itself), a hazard (a kit/trigger_zone's entered: back to
-- `start`) or the finish with every gem (finished, the time; back to
-- `start`) starts the run over: the clock at 0, every linked gem back (and
-- reset, for more). [CRAG_BEST_RESET] The best times are kept state, by the
-- rider's name: play never resets them, a builder's "Clear kept state" does;
-- the five best go out on board (a kit/sign's value) as they change.
-- [KIT_LOBBY] With a kit/lobby's entered linked to start: each rider's clock
-- from their own Play or Again, their gems, crashes and finish counted only
-- then; the finish their result (the time and the best) and the run over.
-- [KIT_BODY_VARS] A rider with every gem (and in their run) has the finish
-- open on their body (c:body_var "finish_open", s.vars in crag_bike's step):
-- the bike holds itself on the finish line, on their client at once; the
-- finish here (the time, the result) still decides. simplified: a last gem
-- taken under a round trip before the line, the client's bike rewinds there.
local function view(c, by)
	local r = c.state.runs[by]
	if not r then
		r = {t = 0, got = 0}
		c.state.runs[by] = r
	end
	return r
end

local function tenths(t)
	return string.format("%.1f", math.floor(t * 10 + 0.5) / 10)
end

local function gems(c)
	return #(c.linked_in.gem or {})
end

local function waits(c)
	return #(c.linked_in.start or {}) > 0
end

-- Its line; a note (what just happened) for two seconds
local function show(c, by, r, note)
	if note then
		r.note, r.note_left = note, 2
	end
	local all = r.got >= gems(c)
	local best = c.state.bests[c:name(by)]
	note = (r.note_left or 0) > 0 and r.note or all and "The finish is open" or nil
	c:emit("hud", "Time " .. tenths(math.max(0, r.t)) .. (best and
			"   Best " .. tenths(best) or "") .. "   Gems " .. r.got .. "/" ..
			gems(c) .. (note and "   " .. note or ""), by)
end

-- The five best, "1. name 12.3|2. ...", out when it changed
local function board(c)
	local all = {}
	for name, t in pairs(c.state.bests) do
		all[#all + 1] = {name, t}
	end
	table.sort(all, function(a, b)
		return a[2] < b[2] or a[2] == b[2] and a[1] < b[1]
	end)
	local lines = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(5, #all) do
		lines[i] = i .. ". " .. all[i][1] .. " " .. tenths(all[i][2])
	end
	local text = table.concat(lines, "|")
	if text ~= c.state.board then
		c.state.board = text
		c:emit("board", text)
	end
end

-- The finish open for the rider's bike as they have every gem in their run
-- (true or nil: only a change sent)
local function open(c, by, r)
	local want = r.got >= gems(c) and (r.playing or not waits(c)) or nil
	if want ~= r.open then
		r.open = want
		c:body_var(by, "finish_open", want)
	end
end

-- Over from the start: the clock held a second (the bike's crash, a teleport)
local function over(c, by, why)
	local r = view(c, by)
	r.t, r.got = -1, 0
	for _, id in ipairs(c.linked_in.gem or {}) do
		c:send(id, "reset", nil, by)
	end
	c:emit("reset", nil, by)
	open(c, by, r)
	c:log(c:name(by) .. ": " .. why .. ", the run starts over")
	show(c, by, r, why:sub(1, 1):upper() .. why:sub(2))
end

return {
	version = 1,
	no_position = true,
	players = true,
	linked_in = true,
	about = {
		group = "Game",
		what = "Crag Trial's run: each rider's clock, gems, finish and best time.",
		inputs = {
			start = "The rider's run starts (a kit/lobby's entered); the clock starts from 0.",
			gem = "The rider took a gem. Every entity linked here is a gem needed to finish.",
			crash = "The rider crashed: the run starts over.",
			hazard = "The rider touched a hazard: back to the start.",
			finish = "The rider reached the finish; it counts as a time if every gem is taken.",
		},
		outputs = {
			hud = "The rider's HUD line. Value: time, best time and gems.",
			reset = "The run started over (the linked gems come back by themselves).",
			finished = "A run finished. Value: its time.",
			result = "A run finished. Value: \"Time 12.3|Best 11.0\", for the rider's result card.",
			board = "The five best times as they change. Value: \"1. name 12.3|2. ...\".",
		},
	},
	params = {
		start = {type = "entity", default = 0},
	},
	state = {
		runs = {default = {}, per_player = true},
		bests = {default = {}, kept = true},
		board = {default = false},
	},
	inputs = {start = "none", gem = "any", crash = "none", hazard = "none",
		finish = "none"},
	outputs = {hud = "string", reset = "none", finished = "number", board = "string",
		result = "string"},
	on_start = function(c)
		c:after(0.1, "tick")
	end,
	-- (back in: in the lobby, no run; their line, the best, as it was)
	on_join = function(c, by)
		local r = view(c, by)
		r.playing, r.open = nil, nil
		show(c, by, r)
	end,
	on_timer = function(c)
		for _, p in ipairs(c.players or {}) do
			local by = "player:" .. p.id
			local r = view(c, by)
			-- (one on another track: not this run's clock)
			if p.here and not p.away and (r.playing or not waits(c)) then
				r.t = r.t + 0.1
				r.note_left = (r.note_left or 0) - 0.1
				show(c, by, r)
				-- (a gem placed or removed meanwhile)
				open(c, by, r)
			end
		end
		board(c)
		c:after(0.1, "tick")
	end,
	on_input = function(c, input, value, by)
		if type(by) ~= "string" or not by:match("^player:%d+$") then
			return
		end
		local r = view(c, by)
		if input == "start" then
			r.playing = true
			over(c, by, "off you go")
			c:teleport(nil, {entity = c.params.start, yaw = 90})
			return
		end
		if waits(c) and not r.playing then
			return
		end
		if input == "gem" then
			r.got = r.got + 1
			c:log(c:name(by), "has", r.got, "of", gems(c), "gems")
			open(c, by, r)
		elseif input == "crash" then
			over(c, by, "crashed")
		elseif input == "hazard" then
			over(c, by, "hit a hazard")
			c:teleport(nil, {entity = c.params.start, yaw = 90})
		elseif input == "finish" then
			if r.got < gems(c) then
				show(c, by, r, "Take every gem first")
				return
			end
			local t = math.max(0, r.t)
			local name = c:name(by)
			local best = not c.state.bests[name] or t < c.state.bests[name]
			if best then
				c.state.bests[name] = t
			end
			r.playing = nil
			c:emit("result", "Time " .. tenths(t) .. "|Best " ..
					tenths(c.state.bests[name]) .. (best and "|Your best yet" or ""), by)
			c:emit("finished", t, by)
			c:log(name, "finished in", tenths(t), best and "(best)" or "")
			over(c, by, "finished in " .. tenths(t) .. (best and ", the best" or ""))
			board(c)
			c:teleport(nil, {entity = c.params.start, yaw = 90})
		end
	end,
}
"}
